notes: Twenty-four source and thirty-two target tokens partitioned exactly once.

The two have clauses are read as light-verb recastings of a present verbal form — the participle נְבוֹנִים and the finite יָדָעוּ — so the supplied verb joins that form's unit and the head goes to the complement under rule 44. Rule 43 does not govern, since no הָיָה, possessive preposition or possessive suffix makes the clause possessive.
אוֹתִי is unrepresented: the ASV writes the object bare in know me not (rule 16's default).
